column2: Have given way to a wild silence
The bars and cafes are closed
The streets are empty, everything is over,
People my age have all disappeared,
I'm bored, don't know what to do with my nights.
The streets are empty, everything is over,
People my age have all disappeared,
I'm bored, don't know what to do with my nights.
I hope one day it will wake up
That people will return to continue savoring it
And that my sadness will disappear.
